snippet.title: ZombMe Trailer
snippet.description:
The trailer for my upcoming indie game, ZombMe.  Play as a zombie as you run, jump, and try to stay...DEAD...

That's right, in this game, you have to stay dead!  Use power-downs, uncover secrets, and recruit helpers as you try to get through this old-school 2D platformer.
